title: Instasteefified Skyblock
description: A high-performance client-side modpack for Hypixel SkyBlock, combining essential QoL mods with Sodium for smoother gameplay and higher FPS.
body:
# Instasteefified Skyblock

This modpack focuses on improving the Hypixel SkyBlock experience by combining essential quality-of-life mods, performance optimizations, and visual enhancements through resource packs.

## User Interface

The main UI mods are Apec, Skyblocker and SkyHanni, which add helpful overlays and information to make all aspects of SkyBlock easier to navigate and understand.

SkyBlock Profile Viewer is included to inspect your own or other players’ profiles.

## Bazaar

Bazaar Utils improves the Bazaar experience by providing clearer price insights and helping with trading decisions, making it easier to manage buying and selling items efficiently.

## Dungeons

Skyblocker improves the dungeon experience with puzzle assistance and secret waypoints, helping you complete runs more efficiently.

## Crafting & Utilities

Firmament is included to support resource packs like FurfSky Reborn and to provide crafting guidance and item information.

Not Enough Calculator allows quick calculations directly inside the Roughly Enough Items (REI) search bar, similar to the mod Not Enough Updates.

## Performance

This modpack is optimized for performance using:

Sodium and ImmediatelyFast for improved rendering performance

FerriteCore for reduced memory usage
